Petitioner/Appellant:
 Xxxxx
Respondents/Respondents:
 State Of Kerala Represented By Public Prosecutor, High Court Of
 Kerala, Ernakulam - 682031.
 Application praying that in the circumstances stated therein the
High Court be pleased to suspend the execution of sentence imposed on the
petitioner/appellant in S.C.No.100/2016 on the files of Court of
Additional Sessions Judge-I,Pathanamthitta till the disposal of the above
appeal.

This Application coming on for orders upon perusing the application and this Court's order dated 26.11.2021 in Crl.MA 2/21 therein and upon hearing the arguments of PRATHAP. S.R.K., Advocate for the petitioner and PUBLIC PROSECUTOR for the respondent, the court passed the following:
The petitioner seeks suspension of sentence.
The appellant- petitioner was convicted for the offence under Section 376 of the Indian Penal Code, 1860 and under Section 4 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO Act).

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act (POCSO Act)
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The period of sentence he has to undergo is ten years of rigorous imprisonment.
2. He has filed Crl.M.A.No.2 of 2021 seeking suspension of sentence.
That petition was dismissed on merits on 26.11.2021.
Therefore, the present petition for suspension of sentence cannot be entertained, especially when there is no change in circumstances.

The further request of the petitioner is that since he suffered a severe heart attack and has been undergoing treatment in the Medical Collage Hospital, Thiruvananthapuram, he may be granted interim bail for getting expert treatment.

Xxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17342867/
1
3. Heard the learned counsel for the petitioner and the learned Public Prosecutor.
4. Report of the Sub-Inspector of police, Koipuram Police Station is made available for my perusal.
It is seen that the victim as well as her mother are afraid of the petitioner.
They expressed their apprehension that in the event of release from jail, the petition may try to attack them.

5. Considering the fact that the petitioner is undergoing treatment for the ailment which is confirmed by the medical report issued by the medical officer in the Central Prison & Correctional Home, Thiruvananthapuram, it is appropriate to grant interim bail for a period of two weeks to the petitioner.
While granting interim bail, the safety and security of the victim as well as her mother have to be safeguarded.
6. In the said circumstances, the request for suspension of sentence is declined.

Sd/-
P.G. AJITHKUMAR, JUDGE Dxy 15-03-2024 /True Copy/ Assistant Registrar Xxxxx vs State Of Kerala on 15 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17342867/

opennyai_summary.decision:
The petitioner seeks suspension of sentence.
That petition was dismissed on merits on 26.11.2021.
While granting interim bail, the safety and security of the victim as well as her mother have to be safeguarded.
6. In the said circumstances, the request for suspension of sentence is declined.
However, the petitioner is granted interim bail for a period of two weeks on his executing a bond for Rs.1,00,000/- (Rupees one lakh only), with two solvent sureties for the like amount each, to the satisfaction of the trial court, subject to the following conditions:
(i) He shall report on Wednesdays between 03:00 and 03:30 p.m., before the Sub-Inspector of Police, Koipuram Police Station;
(ii) During the bail period, he shall not get involved in any offence; and (iii) He shall not contact or try to intimidate the victim or witnesses examined in the case.
